rules:
What may touch: the gripper and whatever group it is picking up, holding or putting down, within 4 s of the
    grasp or release; a held part and the groups it touches when it is taken and when it is let go (where it came
    from and where it goes).
method: FCL 0.7 (python-fcl) mesh-mesh collision on the drawn meshes, arm links decimated to 8000 triangles; every frame of the clip where an arm has moved (its joints, its MiR's pose, what it holds), and every 12th while none has (org_gif.still_skip), after its update
